map.滚动轴承额定寿命 L10 估算，依据基本额定动负荷、当量动负荷与转速计算寿命。: Rolling bearing rated life L10 estimation from the basic dynamic load rating, equivalent dynamic load and speed.
map.a2 材料系数（常规取1），a3 润滑条件系数: a2 material factor (normally 1), a3 lubrication condition factor
map.注：P/C 应小于 0.5 以保证合理疲劳寿命。: Note: P/C should be below 0.5 to guarantee a reasonable fatigue life.
map.按额定动载荷 C 与当量动载荷 P 估算滚动轴承 L10 寿命（90% 可靠度下: Estimate the L10 life of a rolling bearing from the dynamic load rating C and equivalent dynamic load P (the basic rated life at 90% reliability).
map.根据工况（可靠度 90/95/99%、使用条件系数 a3）修正寿命，选型时判断能: Correct the life by working conditions (reliability 90/95/99%, service condition factor a3) to judge during selection whether the design life is met.
map.通过 P/C 负荷比判断选型余量是否合适（过大浪费、过小易早期失效）。: Use the P/C load ratio to judge whether the selection margin is sensible (too large wastes, too small fails early).
map.L10 = (C/P)^ε（百万转），球轴承 ε=3、滚子轴承 ε=10/3；L: L10 = (C/P)^ε (million revolutions), with ε=3 for ball bearings and ε=10/3 for roller bearings; L10h = L10×10⁶/(60·n) (hours); corrected life Lna = a1·a2·a3·L10, where a1 is the reliability factor (90%→1, 95%→0.62, 99%→0.21), a2 the material factor (taken as 1 here) and a3 the service condition factor; the corresponding hours Lnah = Lna×10⁶/(60·n); load ratio = P/C.
map.深沟球轴承 C=50 kN、P=8 kN、转速 1500 r/min、可靠度 9: Deep groove ball bearing C=50 kN, P=8 kN, speed 1500 r/min, reliability 90%, a3=1: L10 = (50000/8000)³ = 6.25³ ≈ 2.44×10² million revolutions; L10h = 244.1×10⁶/(60×1500) ≈ 2713 hours (about 0.3 years of continuous running); P/C = 0.160. Switching to 99% reliability gives a1=0.21 and the corrected life drops to about 570 hours, showing how strongly the reliability requirement affects life.
map.L10 指一批相同轴承中 90% 能达到或超过的寿命（即 10% 失效），是行业: L10 is the life that 90% of a batch of identical bearings can reach or exceed (i.e. 10% fail), which is the industry-standard definition of basic rated life. It is neither the
map.』也不是『保证每台都达到』的寿命。: nor a life guaranteed for every single bearing.
map.为什么提高可靠度寿命会大幅下降？: Why does higher reliability cut the life so much?
map.轴承寿命服从 Weibull 分布、离散度很大；要把失效率从 10% 压到 1%: Bearing life follows the Weibull distribution with large scatter; to push the failure rate from 10% down to 1% (99% reliability) the permissible life must shorten sharply, which is why a1 drops from 1 to 0.21 and life falls to roughly one fifth.
